Name: Mahaneh-dan
Description: The camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol, where the Spirit of the LORD first began to move Samson — the Danite camp ground on the edge of the hill country, named for the tribe that pitched there.
BiblicalSignificance: Mahaneh-dan is where Samson's story begins to stir: the camp between two Danite towns is the ground of his first movings by the Spirit.
